svg.title: Cedar – First response sent (phone call): trigger, actions and retry policy
svg.desc: The flow drawn as boxes from top to bottom. Trigger: Microsoft Dataverse, When a row is added, modified or deleted; change type Added or Modified; table Phone Calls; scope Organization; Select columns statecode; Filter rows statecode eq 1 and directioncode eq true and the regarding value not null; trigger condition: the regarding type equals incidents. Action 1: Get a row by ID from Cases using the regarding ID, selecting title, firstresponsesent and statecode, with the default retry policy. Condition: the case is active and First Response Sent is not yet true. If yes: Update a row on Cases that sets only First Response Sent to Yes, with the retry policy exponential interval, count 4, interval ten seconds, maximum five minutes. If no: the run ends as succeeded without an update. Notes on the right: the flow listens to the activity table and writes to the case table, so it cannot start itself; running twice is harmless; a permanent failure such as 403 is not retried and shows as a failed run; the SLA item of lesson 21 sees the flag and its timer succeeds.
svg.text: Trigger · Dataverse: When a row is added, modified or deleted

Filter rows: statecode eq 1 and directioncode eq true and _regardingobjectid_value ne null
